title: Semantics of a Deterministic Step
statement: Let $A$ be a nondeterministic register machine with oracle, input, guard $G$, and probability $p$. Suppose the instruction at control state $l$ is the deterministic instruction $i$. If the current configuration satisfies $G$ and the configuration obtained by executing $i$ has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$, then the current configuration also has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$.
hypotheses_covered: Instruction at $l$ is the deterministic instruction $i$
$G$ holds at the current live configuration with no answer recorded
The configuration after executing $i$ has probabilistic semantics with probability $p$
